findings.title: Refuse subclasses of allowed descriptor types before lookup
findings.cause: ordinary_test_class unwraps staticmethod/classmethod with isinstance, and selector descriptor allowance also uses isinstance. Custom subclasses can override __get__ while still passing these checks.

findings.minimal_fix: Allow exact staticmethod/classmethod types only; reject custom subclasses before any descriptor lookup. Use static lookup for constructor/dispatch member comparisons as well, so the refusal inspector itself does not execute a custom descriptor.
